verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents strong building blocks for this story: Durable Objects-backed Agents SDK gives each agent persistent state/storage/lifecycle with hibernate/wake, the @cloudflare/think harness backs message persistence with Durable Object SQLite, and Workflows explicitly checkpoint state automatically across steps for minutes/hours/weeks with automatic retries and pause/resume for external events. However, independent community feedback specifically flags that Workers' CPU-time limits (30s free, 15min paid) don't fit long-running agent workloads, a concrete caveat on the 'persistent runtime while working' claim. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification that a coding agent's checkpoint/resume actually works end-to-end in production, and clearer first-party guidance reconciling CPU-time limits with long-running agent sessions.
